patches.title: Clean Verb at Sink
patches.principle: When holding a dirty object at the sink, use the 'clean' action, not 'move' or 'place'.
patches.when_to_apply: When at sinkbasin holding a dirty object.

patches.title: Open Storage Before Placing
patches.principle: Before placing an object into a closed container (drawer, cabinet), open it first.
patches.when_to_apply: When about to place an object into a closed storage.

patches.title: Avoid Cleaning at Wrong Sink
patches.principle: Only use sinkbasin for cleaning; do not attempt to clean at other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding a dirty object and needing to clean it.
